title: Full Offline Support & Quick Track Items
summary: Use the app completely offline with automatic sync when you're back online! Plus, track individual items (snacks, groceries) separately from restaurant visits with the new Quick Track feature and streamlined Process Photos workflow.
features: Full offline mode: Create visits, add items, rate food, and upload photos without internet - everything syncs automatically when you're back online
Sync queue: See all pending operations with status badges and retry failed syncs manually
Quick Track Items: Track individual snacks, groceries, homemade food, and recipes separately from restaurant visits
Process Photos workflow: Upload multiple photos at once and process them all in one streamlined flow
Quick Track in Process Photos: Process photos for both restaurant visits AND quick track items in the same workflow
Friend sharing: Quick track items can be shared with friends or kept private (your choice)
Offline restaurant creation: Add custom restaurants even when offline - they'll sync when you're back online
Clear sync queue: Remove all pending operations with one tap if you change your mind
improvements: Offline indicators: All AI features (menu scanning, restaurant finder) clearly show when unavailable offline
Smart edit preservation: Editing visits now preserves all your custom descriptions and notes
Better restaurant selection: Tabbed interface with Search/Camera/History for faster restaurant finding
Unified Process Photos flow: One-by-one photo processing with restaurant selection, menu items, and ratings all on the same screen
Review before saving: See all your photos and ratings before creating the visit
Menu scanning in Process Photos: Scan menu photos directly in the bulk upload workflow
Quick Track styling: Sleek card-based design matching restaurant visit style
Timeline integration: Quick track items appear in your home feed with subtle styling to distinguish from visits
Optional location field: Location field always visible for quick track items (no more toggle)
Optimistic updates: See your changes instantly while they save in the background
Better error visibility: Failed syncs show clear error messages with retry options
fixes: Fixed edit visit navigation loop and editing issues
Fixed offline restaurant creation hanging
Fixed visit sync errors with temporary IDs
Fixed photo display after online visit creation
Fixed menu items not showing when restaurant is selected in Process Photos
Fixed duplicate menu items appearing in process flow

Fixed visit display for offline-created content
Fixed restaurant creation to use proper createdBy field
